item.text: {"question_id":"5B.6","answer":"In 2023, the administration enacted substantial social-program budgets and maintained some planning and delivery mechanisms, including poverty- and geospatially informed FAIS allocation with quarterly reporting requirements, 6,390 schools using learning-recovery strategies, expanded employment-service modernization, and selected World Bank-supported infrastructure and service outputs (BATCH-0012-E001; BATCH-0012-E003; BATCH-0052-E017; BATCH-0052-E018). These latter results are partly externally financed, cumulative, subnational, or output-based, so they do not establish durable national service quality or personal attribution to López Obrador. The stronger implementation record is mixed to adverse: CONEVAL found that only 69% of priority programs had results orientation, 50% effectively measured results, and 38% showed logical linkage; four management-category programs representing almost 20% of the priority-program budget did not measure results, while recommendations were disregarded to varying degrees (BATCH-0054-E006; BATCH-0052-E004). Health investment was persistently under-executed, with reported reallocation toward flagship projects and loss of smaller health units serving poorer communities; medication shortages and the centralized pharmacy launch further show unresolved delivery risks (BATCH-0048-E010; BATCH-0013-E006). Major projects were frequently inaugurated before completion, with delays, cost escalation, uncertain operating viability, and in some cases weak permitting, technical-study, environmental, or public-participation compliance: the Maya Train opened only partially amid hours-long delays and sharply higher cost estimates, while AIFA depended heavily on federal transfers (BATCH-0011-E002; BATCH-0030-E004; BATCH-0043-E005; BATCH-0010-E008; BATCH-0011-E007). A 2023 public-account audit also reported billions of pesos awaiting substantiation or legal property documentation, although the supplied evidence does not establish personal knowledge, final recovery, or final project outcomes (BATCH-0040-E008). Overall, the supplied record supports enacted resources and selected outputs but not a general finding of timely, high-quality, durable, and well-measured public investment; announcements and implementation weaknesses materially qualify the positive evidence.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0012-E001","BATCH-0012-E003","BATCH-0052-E017","BATCH-0052-E018","BATCH-0054-E006"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0052-E004","BATCH-0048-E010","BATCH-0013-E006","BATCH-0011-E002","BATCH-0030-E004","BATCH-0043-E005","BATCH-0010-E008","BATCH-0011-E007","BATCH-0040-E008"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The evidence does not provide a comprehensive 2023 executed-budget ledger across infrastructure, education, health, technology, administration, and regulation.","Several positive indicators are externally financed, cumulative, subnational, or output measures and do not establish national durability or ruler-specific causation.","Several adverse indicators describe inherited or pre-2023 conditions relevant to the 2023 starting position rather than full-year 2023 outcomes.","The supplied audit and project evidence does not establish final recovery, final environmental effects, stable operation, or the ruler’s personal knowledge of irregularities.","The record does not independently establish that all accelerated inaugurations were patronage projects; it does establish incompleteness, timing pressure, and implementation-quality concerns."] ,"corrections_made":["Removed or qualified the draft’s treatment of World Bank-supported outputs as direct national and ruler-attributable gains.","Reclassified FAIS planning, geospatial tools, digital payments, and selected program outputs as planning or partial implementation evidence rather than proof of durable service delivery.","Added the omitted CONEVAL findings on unclear program definitions, weak results measurement, weak logical linkage, and non-measurement by four budget-significant management programs.","Separated enacted budgets and formal planning from executed investment, service quality, durable outcomes, and personal attribution.","Preserved the period distinction between 2023 evidence, pre-2023 implementation trends, and the later audit reporting on the 2023 public account."] ,"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":["A complete sector-by-sector 2023 execution and outcome ledger could materially refine the balance between selected successes and broad implementation weakness.","Independent evidence on 2023 health, education, infrastructure, and technology service quality and household effects is still limited.","Final operating, cost, environmental, legal-compliance, and audit outcomes for major projects could change the assessment of durability and quality."]}
